title.en: Worn grey treads seen from above

alt.tr: Yukarıdan bakılan yıpranmış gri ahşap merdiven basamakları; üstte sarı boyalı bir basamak
alt.en: Worn grey timber stair treads seen from above, with one yellow-painted tread at the top

caption.tr: Basamaklar griye dönmüş, kenarları aşınmış. En üstteki basamak sarıya boyanmış.
caption.en: The treads have turned grey with worn edges. The topmost tread is painted yellow.
